title: From Rivals to Co-Hosts | Break the Routine with Ballroom Girl Talk
description:
Amanda and Sarah were rivals. Amanda danced with Nikolai, Sarah and Andre were "solo stars," and then the partners swapped: Sarah married Nikolai, Amanda married Andre, and for a few tense years they competed in the same category with the same coaches. Then Amanda texted Sarah to do a podcast and "hash out" everything online, and Ballroom Girl Talk was born. In BTR's first episode with two guests, straight after the Royal Albert Hall, they tell Marius Iepure how they rebuilt the friendship and why everything they do is about giving dancers what they never had growing up, when "everything was hush hush."

Sarah opens up about growing up in New Zealand saving every competition photo on Facebook, realising "I'm not normal," and learning that what made her different was the one thing that would get her where she wanted. Amanda shares how she went from competitive gymnastics to ballet and an ABT summer intensive, then told her mum ballroom was "for old people" before a 10-lesson pack changed her mind. Plus their anonymous submissions and how to tell a pro-am student he has a hygiene problem, sitting on the NDCA Competitors Commission and learning how much those meetings actually do, and body image, from "if you're hungry, eat ice" to an apple a day before a championship.

An honest conversation about rivalry, body image and finally talking about what DanceSport keeps quiet.

Episode out now on YouTube.
